description: Monotonic same-store XML job cancellation through the existing Native queue and engine; no import restart, source fetching, configuration mutation or fabricated rollback.

applied.description: True only for a proved applied atomic catalog; false only for a fenced non-applied cancellation. Null means no authoritative atomic outcome.

cache_settled.description: Verified applied/aborted cache outcome; false keeps an unknown publication protected.

openapi.summary: Cancel a same-store Native XML job.
openapi.description: Requires external authority and a stable Idempotency-Key. Send an empty JSON object. This command does not restart failed work, change the profile or undo a catalog already applied. Unknown atomic outcomes remain protected until verified. The response reports queue cancellation separately from atomic publication settlement.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Same-store Sync job identifier returned by the Native XML import operation.

200.description: Native cancellation acknowledgement; an applied catalog is never rolled back.
